subject: Qualification call recap — model-fit synthesis, benchmarks, and a version watchlist
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Emily Tran <emily.tran@velotrust.com>, Rajesh Iyer <rajesh.iyer@velotrust.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Qualification call recap — model-fit synthesis, benchmarks, and next steps

Hi Emily / Rajesh —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum:

1) Summary of fit from today's demo
- Primary GTM use case: multi-turn customer support routing + policy-aware canned responses.
- Best candidate models from our shortbench: rw-infer-7b-v2 (balanced latency/cost), rw-opt-3b-quant (cost-optimized), rw-guard-13b-safety (higher quality for edge cases). Attached is the short eval packet with example prompts and prompt sets we ran.

2) Benchmarks and artifacts (links & attachments)
- Eval summary (attached): eval_summary_20261129.csv — token-level latency, top-1 accuracy on your sample golden-set, hallucination rate.
- Full artifacts: velotrust_eval_packets.zip (prompt sets, scoring harness, golden examples).
- Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Gv-velotrust-eval

3) Known risk: model-version drift
- During the shortbench we validated rw-infer-7b-v2 @ model_tag v2.3.1. We noted a small regression on the new safety prompts vs v2.2.8 (higher >2% hallucination on the refunds slice). We flagged this in the packet.
- Recommendation: run the attached candidate_prompt_sets.md against your production golden-set and share results so we can recommend pinning.

4) Proposed immediate next steps (action items)
- Emily: share a 200–500 sample goldenset extract (anonymized) or grant read-only access to the folder by EOD Wed.
- VeloTrust: run the included harness or send back the results CSV — we can interpret and advise a pin/canary plan.
- Redwood: if you want, we can prepare a formal pin request for model_tag v2.3.1 and an emergency rollback plan (low-impact canary + 24h watch).

5) Timeline
- If we receive goldenset by Wed, we can deliver a recommended pin/canary plan and a draft SOW for Dedicated/Reserved capacity by next Tue.

Let me know if you want us to start drafting the pin request now (we can prepare it conditionally so procurement has something to review).

Cheers,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop | Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
--
Attachments: velotrust_eval_packets.zip, candidate_prompt_sets.md
From: Emily Tran <emily.tran@velotrust.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Qualification call recap — model-fit synthesis, benchmarks, and next steps

On Mon, Nov 30, 2026 at 2:05 PM Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: ...

Thanks Lauren — this is very helpful. A couple of clarifications from our side: we did a small internal rollout of rw-infer-7b-v2 last week (we were moved automatically from v2.2.8 to v2.3.1 on Nov 29), and our support queue saw an uptick in false-positive policy flags and some answer omissions on multi-step refunds. We captured examples in an internal ticket and attached a short CSV — I've uploaded that to the shared folder.

Two asks from procurement/ops perspective:
- Can Redwood prepare an immediate mitigation (pin to previous tag v2.2.8) while we validate? Procurement will need the timeline + impact statement to approve a temporary change.
- If we pin, what's the expected downtime or risk to traffic shaping? We need minimal disruption; any canary approach would be preferred.

Happy to grant read-only access to the goldenset — I'll share a link by EOD.

Emily
Emily Tran | Head of ML Platform
VeloTrust
Attachments: prod_regression_examples.csv (in shared folder)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Emily Tran <emily.tran@velotrust.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Qualification call recap — model-fit synthesis, benchmarks, and next steps

Emily — thanks for the quick note and for uploading the examples.

We can help with a low-risk mitigation path. Proposed technical approach:
- Short-term: Pin routing for VeloTrust to rw-infer-7b-v2@v2.2.8 (the last-known-good) for up to 72 hours while we run a focused regression triage. No model artifacts need to be changed on your side; this is a serving-level routing override.
- Canary plan (recommended): 2% of traffic -> pinned tag v2.2.8 for 6 hours, analyze key metrics (policy false-positives, answer recall on refunds slice, latency). If metrics improve, escalate to 10% for 12 hours, then full shift. If metrics degrade, automatic fallback to v2.3.1.
- Expected impact: sub-second switching — there is no customer-facing downtime. Routing takes effect within a minute; session-level consistency is preserved by sticky routing for the user session.

What we need from VeloTrust to proceed:
- Formal approval from procurement (we can provide a 1-page impact statement for procurement to sign).
- A small labeled golden sample (100–200 rows) to anchor the regression signals we will monitor.
- Confirm the window you're comfortable with for a 72-hour temporary pin.

I've attached a pre-filled pin_request_form.pdf to speed procurement review and included a short checklist inside the Drive folder (see link). I'll open INF-9876 internally to track the snapshot/pin ops work.

If you approve, we'll kick off the canary tonight (PST) and loop in EngOps: @Karthik (cc) — can you reserve a snapshot for DEAL-7842 and stage the fallback policy?

Thanks —
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
Attachments: pin_request_form.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Qualification call recap — model-fit synthesis, benchmarks, and next steps

Internal ops note — creating INF-9876 and adding the following action items:
- Create immutable snapshot for VeloTrust traffic at 2026-12-01T11:05 PST and tag as velotrust-snapshot-20261201.
- Stage routing override for rw-infer-7b-v2@v2.2.8 and prepare automatic rollback to v2.3.1 after 24h if no improvements.
- Prepare monitoring dashboard (policy-fp-rate, refunds-recall, p95 latency) and a short alert rule for >1.5x regression.

Karthik — please confirm you have capacity to run the canary tonight; aim to have the snapshot and pin staged by 18:00 PST. Priyom — please attach the eval harness results back into the INF ticket once the 2% canary runs complete.

I'll update Emily after the snapshot is in place.

Marcus
Marcus Lin | Director, Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
